name: Mine-Reeve Coppin
title: Reeve of the Deep Market
examine: Lamp-soot freckles and a ring of chalk-marked keys. The Undercroft answers to the Warden, the Warden answers to the ledger, and the ledger answers to Coppin.
lines: Welcome below. Market spine's swept and lit; past the rubble line you're your own insurance.
The guild broke the seal, the Warden signed for it, and I keep the books down here where the ink stays cool.
Twenty years sealed and the market floor was clean when they opened it. I don't sweep it either. It just stays swept. We've all agreed to be busy about it.
